method: Manual visual review of original RGBA on light/neutral/dark backgrounds, with alpha-row spans checked at native pixels. Coordinates are rough contour candidates only; no source calibration or fit was applied.

proximalSkinBoundary.interpretation: Bare-skin proximal edge after cuff removal. This is a part cut/overlap boundary, not an anatomical elbow. Intended hidden overlap under upper sleeve remains unverified in an assembly.

wristNeck.evidence: Alpha>128 row width is about 121px at y=650–660, then expands to about 139px by y=720 and 170px by y=780. The narrow-to-palm transition is a visual wrist-neck candidate only, not a sealed joint center.

palmCenter.evidence: Broad hand silhouette below the wrist-neck candidate.

thumb.evidence: Distinct nail-bearing digit lies on viewer-right/body-interior edge, consistent with actor RIGHT thumb ownership. Points are not sealed landmarks.

fingertipExtent.evidence: Lowest opaque curled fingertip; alpha>128 bounding box ends at y=1092 inclusive.

handLengthConcern.note: Using the rough wrist-neck contour only, the apparent hand extension remains about 1.4–1.8x the 4x guide estimate. No local-unit length or calibration is asserted.

decision: Cuff removal and bare-skin scope appear achieved. The output still has a strongly curled hand and a visibly long wrist-to-fingertip span relative to the approved geometry guide. Parent inspection is required; no retry is authorized.
